mode: Indoor operator rescue; default forward window view contains dunes and Mira.
scope: Actual rendered working-tree game; not proof of a published release archive, physical-device performance or child playtesting.
renderer: OpenGL Compatibility; Mesa 25.0.7 llvmpipe LLVM 19.1.7 software rendering
image_processing: None. PNG files copied directly from Godot viewport captures; no crops, compositing, color changes or overlays added.

views.0.7-title.png: Default near-window title camera inside mission control, with dunes, stranded Mira and three primary choices.
views.0.7-mission.png: Default first-person indoor operator view; explicit Mira suit/exposure labels and three controls.
views.0.7-controls.png: The same mission paused in controls mode with optional Details open.
views.0.7-rescue-arrival.png: Mira protected after travel, airlock cycle and indoor entry. Player turns toward her using an injected mouse event; this is behavior evidence, not a new default camera.

capture_sequence: Fresh process after the final operator boundary-hint change. Production main scene; keyboard Start; Tab/pointer Details; pause/resume and cleaner checks; Tab/pointer Guide Mira; ordinary controller steps advance the journey; mouse event turns view toward arrived Mira.

arrival_time_advancement.method: Production game._process calls without wall-clock waits. No character coordinates, rescue phases, mission shelter values or physics equations assigned for the image.

input_verification.method: Actual engine with injected keyboard/pointer events; verifies operator defaults, crew labels, title/actions, pause/resource freeze, capture/focus, Details bounds, cleaner/Guide Mira interactions and completed entry.

independent_semantic_verification.method: Headless actual-game controller review with accelerated ordinary steps and explicit negative-state fixtures. Tests full guide-and-save success, no-action dose abort, crew independence, pause, no instant shield, terminal guards and tour reset. Not a wall-clock playthrough.

release_association.verification: All recorded runtime source and image hashes match; captures remain source-project renders, not exported-installer captures.
